conf.description: Windows DNS/DHCP dhcp-audit / other: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-integration).

conf.comment: windows-dns-dhcp / dhcp-audit / other. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (Microsoft DHCP integration (microsoft_dhcp)). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).
